title: User Account Control (UAC) is Disabled
description: User Account Control prevents unauthorized malware and processes from silently acquiring administrator privileges.
impact: All applications run with full administrative rights without prompt or isolation, neutralizing Windows security boundaries.
remediation_guidance: Set HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\EnableLUA to 1 and restart the computer.

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'User Account Control: Run all administrators in Admin Approval Mode' is set to 'Enabled'

title: UAC Secure Desktop Elevation is Disabled
description: The Secure Desktop isolates credential prompts from standard desktop windows, preventing spoofing and clickjacking.
impact: Malicious background processes can spoof UAC prompts or inject simulated clicks to gain silent privilege escalation.

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'User Account Control: Switch to the secure desktop when prompting for elevation' is set to 'Enabled'

title: UAC Administrator Elevation Behavior Set to Elevate Without Prompting
description: ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin must be set to prompt for consent (2 or 5) rather than automatically elevating silently.
impact: Software running in user context can escalate directly to SYSTEM/High-Integrity without administrative review.

compliance_mappings.title: Ensure 'User Account Control: Behavior of the elevation prompt for administrators' is set to 'Prompt for consent'
